description: This file defines interfaces, classes, enums, and structures related to broadcast signal handling, including tuner control, section handling, and modulation parameters within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::ISection
classes.description: Interface for handling sections, with a virtual destructor and a handle method for processing MPEG sections.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::IMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring, with a method to change PIDs.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::IteratorType
classes.description: Template class for iterating over a list of objects, supporting reset, next, and current operations.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::ITuner
classes.description: Interface for tuner control, including properties, state management, tuning, filtering, attaching/detaching, and callback handling.

methods.name: ConvertBCD
methods.description: Template function to convert a buffer of BCD-encoded digits into a numeric type.
